title: House Cleaning Business Software (2026): 6 Tools, Prices
description: House cleaning software compared: ZenMaid from $19/mo + $4/cleaner, Maidily free plan, Launch27 $75/mo unlimited users, BookingKoala, Jobber, Housecall Pro.
h1: House cleaning business software: maid service apps compared
body:
House cleaning and maid service software has to do three things well: let customers book a clean online (often priced by bedrooms, bathrooms or square feet), keep recurring weekly and biweekly cleans on the right cleaner’s calendar, and charge the card on file after the visit. How you’re billed matters as much as features. Some tools charge for every cleaner, some for every job, and some include unlimited users. Below are six tools whose prices we checked on the vendors’ own pages on November 23, 2026: three apps built for maid services (ZenMaid, Launch27, Maidily), the booking-first BookingKoala, and the general field service apps Jobber and Housecall Pro, both of which have cleaning-specific pages. Anything a vendor doesn’t publish is marked unknown.

What it costs for a solo cleaner, a 5-person team and a 10-person team

These are monthly prices with no commitment, before SMS, card fees and tax, worked out from each pricing page on 2026-11-23. We assume a solo owner doing 30 cleans a month, an owner plus 4 cleaners doing 120, and an owner plus 9 cleaners doing 250. For BookingKoala we count every team member as a provider, which is how its pricing page defines a provider. Annual prices are in brackets where the vendor publishes them.

Which one fits your cleaning business

  • Just starting, under 40 cleans a month: ZenMaid Starter ($19) or Maidily. Maidily’s Free plan covers up to 10 jobs a month and Start ($29) covers 50. Both take card payments through Stripe or Square. Other $0 options are in free field service software.
  • Lots of part-time or contract cleaners: tools that don’t charge per seat. Maidily is priced by jobs, Launch27 includes unlimited users from $75, and BookingKoala Starter covers 5 providers from $27. On ZenMaid, every active cleaner profile costs money, contractors included.
  • Customers book on your website: Launch27 and BookingKoala are built around a customer booking form. Launch27 can price by bedrooms and bathrooms, hours or square feet. BookingKoala includes a website builder on every plan.
  • You need QuickBooks today: Launch27 Pro, Maidily Grow, Jobber Connect or Housecall Pro Essentials. ZenMaid’s native QuickBooks integration was still marked “coming soon” on 2026-11-23. See field service software with QuickBooks for how each sync works.
  • You also do windows, carpets or pressure washing: Jobber or Housecall Pro handle quotes with optional add-ons, one-off jobs and routing alongside recurring cleans. Compare them in Jobber vs Housecall Pro, and see window cleaning software.

faq: How much does house cleaning business software cost?

From the vendor pricing pages checked 2026-11-23: Maidily has a free plan for up to 10 jobs a month and paid plans from $29/mo. ZenMaid starts at $19/mo for the owner plus $4-$24/mo for each extra cleaner or office manager. BookingKoala starts from $27/mo for 5 providers, Launch27 at $75/mo with unlimited users, Jobber at $49/mo monthly ($29/mo billed annually) and Housecall Pro at $79/mo monthly ($59/mo billed annually).

Yes. ZenMaid's help center says only the owner profile is in the base price. Every other active profile (employee cleaners, contractor cleaners and office managers) costs $4/mo on Starter, $14/mo on Pro and $24/mo on Pro Max. Only active roles are charged, and SMS is billed separately in bundles starting at $14 for 125 messages.
Which maid service software has unlimited users?

Launch27 includes unlimited users and bookings on all three plans ($75, $150 and $299/mo). Maidily includes unlimited users on every plan, including Free, and charges by jobs per month instead. BookingKoala charges by providers (5 on Starter, 15 on Growing, 50 on Premium).

Not natively yet. ZenMaid's pricing page lists a QuickBooks integration on Pro marked "Coming soon" (checked 2026-11-23). Its help center says QuickBooks Online can be connected through Zapier, which needs the Pro Max plan plus a paid Zapier plan, because QuickBooks Online is a Premium Zapier app.
What counts as a job on Maidily?

Maidily's pricing FAQ says a job is any scheduled cleaning appointment, and each occurrence of a recurring cleaning counts as a separate job. A client cleaned weekly uses about 4 to 5 jobs a month. If you go over your plan's limit, you buy packs of 50 extra jobs ($3/mo on Start, $8 on Grow, $14 on Scale).
